Photos: Tailgate ahead of the Iowa at Minnesota football game
results.description: MINNEAPOLIS, Minn. — Fans tailgate near Huntington Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota before the game for the Floyd of Rosedale trophy between the Iowa Hawkeyes and Minnesota Gophers. The Hawkeyes went on to lose to the Gophers 13-10 in a sloppy game. The post Photos: Tailgate ahead of the Iowa at Minnesota football game appeared first on The Daily Iowan.
